user.title: Connect to a local Tapo camera
user.description: Enter the camera's LAN address and its **camera account** credentials (local only - no TP-Link cloud account is used).

rtsp.title: RTSP credentials
rtsp.description: The RTSP stream can use a different account from the API. Leave blank to reuse the camera account above.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The camera rejected the stored credentials. Enter the current ones.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the camera at that address.
error.unknown: Unexpected error talking to the camera.

motor_at_limit.message: The camera is already at the end of its travel in that direction.

motor_busy.message: The camera motor is busy. Try again in a moment.

preset_missing.message: Preset {name} no longer exists on the camera.
